subject: TriAxis: Private deployment architecture & ops deep-dive (scheduling)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Samira Nadeem <samira@triaxis.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: TriAxis: Private deployment architecture & ops deep-dive (scheduling)

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — the TriAxis use case (air-gapped on-prem for clinical analytics) sounds like a great fit for a focused architecture review. The goal for the session would be:

- Walk through TriAxis network & security constraints (VPC, air-gap, jump boxes)
- Explain Redwood Private packaging (on-prem install, KMS/HSM options, offline install flow)
- Share pre-reads & artifacts we need for a smooth install (network diagram, firewall rules, certs)
- Identify any gaps and next steps (P0/P1 blockers, timeline, trial/validation plan)

Would you and Liam be available for a 60–90 minute deep-dive next week? Suggested windows (PT):
- Tue 2027-06-15 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2027-06-16 14:00–15:30
- Tue 2027-06-22 10:00–11:30

I’ll include Monica (solutions engineer) to cover deployment details and Karthik for security/compliance if needed — please let me know who else from your side should join (network, infra, compliance).

I attached our high-level deploy checklist to help TriAxis prepare. If you prefer, we can do a short pre-call (30m) with your infra lead to capture constraints before the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_deploy_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Samira Nadeem <samira@triaxis.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@triaxis.health>, Paul Green <paul.green@infra-partners.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TriAxis: Private deployment architecture & ops deep-dive (scheduling)

Hi Marcus — thank you.

We are definitely interested. A couple of constraints to flag up front:
- TriAxis operates an air-gapped environment for PHI processing — no outbound internet traffic from the cluster. Any installer must support fully offline installs and air-gapped updates.
- Our security/compliance team will want to review SOC2 evidence, audit-log format (WORM), and key management options (KMS vs HSM).

Liam (CC'd) is our Head of Infrastructure and will join. We also use a third-party integrator (Paul Green) for on-prem appliance installs — he can join for the ops details.

Of the slots you proposed, Tue 2027-06-22 10:00–11:30 PT looks best for us. If that works, please send an invite and any pre-read we should review.

Attaching our internal network requirements doc so you can see constraints ahead of time.

Best,
Samira Nadeem
Director, IT & Infrastructure | TriAxis Medical
samira@triaxis.health

Date: 2027-06-12T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TriAxis: Private deployment architecture & ops deep-dive (scheduling)

Thanks Samira — Tue 2027-06-22 10:00–11:30 PT is tentatively OK on our side. I’ve penciled the slot and will send a formal invite once we confirm with Karthik and Monica.

Proposed agenda (60–90m):
1) 10m — Introductions & goals (TriAxis requirements)
2) 30–40m — Architecture walkthrough (TriAxis network diagram + Redwood Private install flow)
3) 10–15m — Security/compliance deep-dive (KMS/HSM, audit logs, artifact access)
4) 10–15m — Open items & next steps (trial images, offline install runbook, on-site/integrator plan)

Pre-reads attached: our deploy checklist and a short runbook excerpt. Monica will prepare a short slide showing the offline installer flow and HSM integrations. Karthik — can you confirm what additional evidence TriAxis will need (SOC2 scope, encryption details)?

If all good, I’ll send a calendar invite with a dial-in option (I understand you may prefer phone for air-gapped environments).

—Marcus

Date: 2027-06-13T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TriAxis: Private deployment architecture & ops deep-dive (scheduling)

Hi team — quick notes from the security side to make sure the deep-dive is productive:

Please include the following in the pre-read or have answers ready in the call:
- KMS/HSM: supported integrations (on-prem HSM vendors, cloud KMS sync patterns) and whether keys can be customer-managed and rotated offline.
- Audit logs: format, retention defaults, support for WORM or export to customer SIEM.
- Installer artifacts: are images signed? process for verifying image integrity offline?
- Network: required open ports, jump-box architecture, and any temporary egress for licensing/telemetry (we should plan zero outbound).
- Evidence: SOC2 summary, any penetration test reports, and contact for compliance questionnaire follow-up.

If possible, send the minimal set of artifacts before EOD 2027-06-16 so we can circulate them internally. Also recommend including an engineering lead from TriAxis who can answer environment-specific questions during the call.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Samira Nadeem <samira@triaxis.health>

Date: 2027-06-14T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TriAxis: Private deployment architecture & ops deep-dive (scheduling)

Marcus — quick update. Our infra schedule shifted and we need to move the deep-dive to Thu 2027-06-24 14:00–15:30 PT. That window works better for Liam and Paul.

Notes & attachments I’m sharing ahead of the call:
- network_diagram_v1.png (high-level VLANs, jump box, management network)
- TriAxis_internal_policy_v2.pdf (key compliance excerpts)
- Signed NDA: TriAxis_NDA_signed.pdf

Two important operational constraints to confirm before the meeting:
1) Offline install only: TriAxis cannot allow any temporary outbound connections from the cluster. Can Redwood provide an offline installer plus a written runbook for the complete install/upgrade flow?
2) Image signing & verification: we’ll need a documented signature verification process for images we install.

We will not be able to use Zoom in the air-gapped cluster. For the call we’ll dial in from a corporate phone bridge. Please include dial-in details in the calendar invite and a link to the pre-reads in a location we can access (we will coordinate with Paul for internal transfer).

If you can confirm the new slot and that you will share pre-reads by EOD 2027-06-16, we’ll lock the time.

Thanks,
Samira
